question: What is the build number of the latest Autodesk Fusion release?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 release, the latest build is v.2706.1.17, dated October 28, 2026 [1].

It is a minor update to the October 2026 Major Product Update, which was first released as v.2706.1.14 on October 21, 2026 [1]. The v.2706.1.17 update improved stability when moving components or rolling back the timeline in assemblies with inconsistent component data, and it fixed a blank Render workspace when a section analysis was active [1]. The same build number appears in search snippets from the Fusion blog [6][7][8].

I found nothing in the sources about a newer build after October 28, 2026.

keyPoints.text: The latest minor update listed on the October 2026 Fusion blog is v.2706.1.17, dated October 28, 2026.
The October 2026 release highlights list v.2706.1.14 dated October 21, 2026, which is an earlier build.
The What's New archive page (dated 2026-10-29) lists the October 2026 major update but does not state a build number.
Search snippets from the Fusion blog also show v.2706.1.17 as the October 28, 2026 release.

conflicts.text: One search snippet spells the date as 'Ocotber 28, 2026' while others say October 28, 2026; the build number itself is consistent.

mayBeStale.text: The Fusion blog and support pages are dated October–November 2026, so a newer build may have shipped after these were captured.
